news.title: U.S.-sanctioned Moscow Exchange to list bitcoin and Tether’s USDT in December
news.summary: Russia’s main bourse wants back the crypto trading Russians do abroad, and one of the coins it's listing is issued by a company that freezes wallets on the U.S. sanctions list.

news.title: South Korea's ruling party wants to delay its crypto tax again
news.summary: South Korea's ruling party wants to delay crypto tax by about two years, as it waits for global tax-sharing rules and new digital assets law.

news.title: Democrats surge toward Senate, House majorities, with crypto braced for new direction
news.summary: The dominance of Republicans in all three government branches has been broken by the midterms, and the industry will feel the result as Congress changes hands.
